verdict.rationale:
Cekura's observability API ingests live call transcripts via webhook (send-calls) and automatically schedules metric evaluation, with dedicated 'live drift detection across every call' and per-metric sampling to control cost on high-volume production traffic — clearly going beyond offline dataset evals. Integrations for Retell/VAPI/LiveKit observability further confirm production-traffic monitoring is a first-class capability.

Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of continuous evaluation at production scale and latency characteristics of live evaluation.
